priorityList: Summon Infernal on cooldown for major burst damage during AoE encounters.
Cast Malevolence as soon as it is available, ideally while Infernal is active.
Cast Cataclysm to apply Wither to all targets and provide initial burst.
Maintain Havoc on a secondary target when fighting 2-3 enemies to cleave your spells.
Cast Rain of Fire as your primary Soul Shard spender if there are 4 or more enemies.
Cast Chaos Bolt as your primary Soul Shard spender if there are 2-3 enemies.
Cast Soul Fire if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards and the target will survive the cast.
Use Shadowburn if Malevolence is active or if you have Fiendish Cruelty procs.
Use Shadowburn as a finisher on targets below 20% health.
Cast Conflagrate to generate Soul Shards and maintain Backdraft stacks, ensuring you don't cap at 2 charges.
Manually refresh Wither on targets if Cataclysm is on cooldown and the DoT is entering its pandemic window (under 30% duration).
Use Incinerate as your primary filler, especially if Fire and Brimstone is talented and Backdraft is active.
Use Ruination whenever it becomes available from Diabolic Ritual procs.
Use your offensive trinkets and potions during your Infernal and Malevolence windows for maximum impact.
